method: Input set computed with python3 -I: union of triage lanes[*].rows whose register status is not COMPLETE and whose register JSON contains 2026-10-18 (333) and real_missing_large rows not COMPLETE (113), 446 rows at head 92ee2a64. Eight read-only subagents classified about 56 rows each from the register text and the code it names. The coordinator then re-checked every CODE_CLOSABLE and ALREADY_COMPLETE verdict by grep against the code (only 15 and 4 existed, fewer than the 20 and 10 asked for), downgraded four, and nothing was built or run. Graders read code unevenly: many DESIGN_DECISION and LARGE calls rest on the gap text, not a code read.

rows.closure: Owner/ADR must say what UNDERSTAND does with a MarketStatePack and who builds one in the cycle.
rows.reason: MarketStatePack carries only kind, interval, horizon, lineage and integrity flags (no book/flow/liquidity values), and no kernel code builds or reads one (grep MarketStatePack: only qip-contracts). A consumer needs a producer from ticks (tick desk, off by default) and a defined effect on UNDERSTAND; both are choices, not wiring. Question: is the pack an advisory integrity annotation on the world model, or an input to a regime/feature read, and does the cycle (bars only) ever hold events to build it from?

rows.closure: Decide what trade a lapsed/missed opportunity is priced as (opportunity direction at a reference size, or REASON's declined hypothesis) and add a capture site.
rows.reason: platform.rs::capture_unworked records Action::ExpiredOpportunity and its doc says it is deliberately unpriced since no side/size was ever proposed; Action::MissedOpportunity has no kernel producer. Pricing needs an invented side and size, which is a design choice (a zero would be a number nobody computed).

rows.closure: Decide whether connector sources enter DataFinder's registry for periodic re-assessment and who measures latency, before wiring observe_health.
rows.reason: ConnectorArm::poll (connectors.rs) returns only records or an error, so no latency exists to build HealthObservation::served, and connector source ids are never re-assessed through DataFinder::assess, so history fed in would be read by nothing. Gap text confirmed by code.

rows.closure: Decide what the alternative to a hedged or unwound path is (unhedged hold? held-to-horizon position?) before queues and a twin arm.
rows.reason: evaluate_alternatives prices a placed order's size arms only; DECIDE's hedge survey output is 'a proposal, never a position' so there is no hedge/unwind record to price. Partial-fill half already closed per register.

rows.closure: Split: (1) additive optional intent fields (instrument/side/qty) on edge DeltaRefusal at the cell refusal sites that hold an intent, with qip-mesh decode and the wire-compat test; (2) ingest_cell_report queues them into score_declined; (3) test in qip-kernel/tests/learning.rs. Blocked by R12-MESH-5068.
rows.reason: Desk half already learned from (capture_submission queues sizing refusals for score_declined). Edge half needs the cell wire to carry the refused intent: edge/qip-edge/src/mesh.rs::DeltaRefusal and qip-mesh/src/delta.rs::DeltaRefusal hold only gate, reason, venue. Depends on R12-MESH-5068.

rows.closure: Decide how a DigitalAsset order routes to a simulated DEX and settles on chain confirmations; qip-kernel does not depend on qip-brokers.
rows.reason: qip-brokers::dex::DexVenue is a model only: its module doc says it deliberately does not implement VenueAdapter (no submit_order), and qip-kernel/Cargo.toml has no qip-brokers edge. Registering it 'beside the simulated broker' as the triage proposed is not possible as written; routing and settlement semantics are a design choice.

rows.closure: Decide whether the kernel's FederationStage (already constructed each UNDERSTAND pass) satisfies 'constructed in the production organisation', or the federation must be a Desk Brain emitting Findings with coverage tied to the agent roster.
rows.reason: federation_stage.rs builds and runs the Federation per pass, has REQUIRED_FAMILIES/uncovered scope reporting, and since ADR 0125 decision 4 narrowings_of/narrow multiply a material spread into DECIDE caps, so 'recorded, never acted on' is wrong. What remains is whether it must also be a Brain in the agent organisation.

Then regrade the row text.

Only the pure veto_observations pricing is tested (a_repeated_veto_gap_carries_the_earnings_its_gate_forwent); the platform-to-sweep read is untested. Carry-over/cap-defer already pinned by learning.rs test. Fixture feasibility not run.

RISK: synthesise always adds a direct Stance::Supports item knowable at as_of, so the fixture needs a crafted opportunity (anomaly detected_at after now) or a test seam and must clear red-team confidence; if no honest fixture exists, this becomes a design question about an unreachable guard.
